title: Dave Heyne
summary: David Heyne is an American automotive designer who interned at Mattel from January to March 2009. He developed various vehicle concepts for "various entertainment properties" and the core Hot Wheels brand. Prior to working at Mattel he worked for Facelift Concept, D&D Classic Coachbuilders and competing brand Hasbro; he currently works as a Senior Creative Designer for General Motors.
